lines: Episode 405 (2026-10-20). The host opens with three shows left before her maternity leave and frames the episode as "a tale of two patsies". She says Brian Cole Jr. – the black autistic man whom, in her words, Kash Patel and Dan Bongino appear to have blamed for the January 2021 pipe bombs – may be exonerated by independent journalist Steve Baker's CCTV review. According to the host and the clips she plays, Baker's team places Cole across town at 7:57 p.m. while the suspect was on camera elsewhere, and identifies his shoes, a tagged Christmas jacket his grandmother Loretta Cole says she bought him, and a hand-made Washington Football Team mask. The host links Scripps Media's release of an old Cole traffic stop to Carl Bernstein's reporting on CIA-linked outlets and Operation Mockingbird.

The main segment presents what the host calls exclusive UVU footage from September 10. She recalls Officer Bagley's preliminary-hearing testimony that he did not review video of the Losee rooftop between the 12:23 p.m. jump and his 12:44 p.m. arrival. She says a tall figure she nicknames "Slender Man" returned to the rooftop ledge from about 12:35, lingered, walked back and forth, went back to the ledge at 12:40 when the footage blacks out for about a minute, and left at 12:42, shortly before Bagley arrived and found the screwdriver. Explicitly as her opinion, she speculates that the missing minute might show the screwdriver being dropped, and repeats that she does not believe Charlie Kirk was shot from the Losee rooftop.

The host releases two more "Hokey Pokémon" cards (General McCoy and "F B Eyes"). She then answers Jeremy Boreing, reading an X exchange in which he says she lies, and showing excerpts from her Daily Wire firing document that cite her genocide tweet. She discusses reports that Kimberly Guilfoyle was pushed out as ambassador to Greece, including the allegation that she asked Eric Deters for $100,000, and says she is "team Kimberly Guilfoyle" compared with alleged Trump-family corruption. The comments segment covers Tyler Bowyer and the statue, a viewer's bot-farm remark, Katie Zacharia, and the host's renewed permission for Boreing to release her full firing documents.

lines: - MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Brian Cole Jr." -> "Brian Cole Jr." (00:01:05, 00:01:44) source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihLQRXxIfjU (chapter title "Brian Cole Jr. vindicated")

- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Lozi seat" / "Losee" / "Losee" / "Losee" / "Loews Hotel" -> "Losee (Center)" (00:12:24, 00:13:38, 00:14:08, 00:17:38, 00:21:00, 00:24:02, 00:27:25) source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihLQRXxIfjU (episode title "Losee Rooftop")
- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Kohl's jacket" / "Kohl's credit card" -> "Kohl's" (00:07:59, 00:08:30) source: context (department-store credit card and purchase record)
- MISTRANSCRIPTION: "Blake Neff" -> "Blake Neff" (00:30:38) source: N-159; prior episodes on Neff's account of McCoy
- Unresolved name: "Latif and bot farm" (00:48:05) and "Latin bot farms" (00:46:29, viewer comment); could not confirm the intended name; transcript spelling kept.
- Unresolved name: "Kel Kelly Fuller" (00:33:54), the X user in the Boreing thread; private poster, no node minted.
- Unresolved: "Then it was Howard Scripps" (00:05:17) is probably "Scripps-Howard"; kept as said.
- The host says "the feds were responsible for February 6th" (00:02:57); likely means January 6th. Kept as said.
- The firing document as read says "October 7th, 2024" (00:36:51); the attacks were on October 7, 2023. Kept as read.
- The host gives the suspect's jump as 12:23 p.m. (00:13:38) but later says "jumped off the Loews Hotel rooftop at 12:35 p.m." (00:17:38); recorded as said in C-14512.

- The "F B Eyes" card (00:31:11) describes "33" points, "See you in Valhalla", "Beast Mode", beer in a locker room and "country music sensations"; this probably refers to Kash Patel, but the host does not name him, so no Mentions were added.
- Clip speakers in the Cole segment (00:07:26–00:11:19) are not named on air; the speaker refers to "Bryan Senior" and "Bryan's mother". Attributed as "a speaker".
- Garbled merch line "make him a hot dog a lot to hay mug" (00:51:24); no claim made.
- Artifacts referenced but not clearly shown: the Axios report (A-3430.1, verbal reference only); the viewer tip (A-3424.2, verbal reference only).

- DIA scan: "candaceowens.com" (00:51:24) is a merch plug, not a tip request, so it is not a DIA beat. "sent me over a tip" (00:04:04) is a tip payoff and is logged as a DIA beat (C-14484, A-3424.2, M-12), although it does not match a keyword exactly.

- Privacy omissions: the viewer comment from "Kiwi Kel"/Kelly (00:45:58, 00:50:53) on her father's dementia and her cancer scan, and the birthday request for Sarah Aziz (00:45:22), are private personal details of private individuals; no claims made.

- Rejected claims (admission test): "the feds might even be intentionally targeting autistic uh teenagers and adults" (00:01:05; speculative generalisation); "Release Brian Cole Jr." (00:09:01; demand); "He has betrayed everyone including Charlie Kirk" (00:41:30; opinion); "I think they should pay her off" (00:42:02; opinion); "I'm team Kimberly Guilfoyle" (00:40:58; opinion); Pre-Born, Balance of Nature, Wild Pastures and American Financing ad copy (sponsor claims, not case claims).
